svg.title: Construction Connect — monorepo architecture diagram
svg.desc: Three-client monorepo showing frontend (React/Vite), mobile (Expo React Native), and backend (NestJS) sharing a single PostgreSQL database. Arrows show HTTP REST and WatermelonDB sync flows.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the frontend authenticate with the backend?')
sendPrompt('How does the mobile app authenticate?')
sendPrompt('What NestJS modules exist in the backend?')
sendPrompt('What tables are in the PostgreSQL database?')
sendPrompt('What files are stored in S3?')
